workshoptitle: Deploy and Run Apache Hadoop & Spark on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Introduction to Hadoop & Spark on OCI

tutorials.description: Connect via OCI Bastion and run the serverless ETL, Hadoop analytics, warm-pool, and secure HA use cases

tutorials.description: Connect via OCI Bastion and run the Spark-only, HDFS+Spark, and Object Storage+Spark demos

tutorials.description: Clean up the resources created in this workshop
